message: the stage at line 1 in Dockerfile (line 2) runs Bun with --minimum-release-age=0, which turns off the release-age delay of Bun (3d in depcurfew.json)
fix: Remove --minimum-release-age=0 from that command in Dockerfile; for a package that cannot wait, add it to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply

message: the stage at line 1 in Dockerfile (line 2) runs Bun with --trust, which lets dependency install scripts run that depcurfew.json denies for Bun
fix: Remove --trust from that command in Dockerfile; to let a package run its install scripts, add it to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply
